about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in the magical world of Van Gogh’s brushstrokes? Explore 5 unique maps filled with vibrant colors and dynamic brush marks. Discover cats hiding in these hand-drawn scenes and color each one by numbers to bring this unique artistic atmosphere to life!

Each map offers a detailed and lively atmosphere reflecting Van Gogh’s signature style. Can you find the cats hidden in this magical world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Experience this artistic world with the relaxing power of colors and vivid brushstrokes!

✨ Features:

🎨 5 unique Van Gogh brushstroke maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed Van Gogh radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
